hardware: Intel Xeon Gold 6326 @ 2.90 GHz, 16 physical cores
software: custom CUDA kernels based on FlashAttention
datasets: SCBench: Many-Shot, RepoQA, Multi-Choice QA, MathFind, Retrieve Prefix-Suffix, KV, Summary
baselines: original dynamic Ada-SnapKV, Expected Attention, FastKVzip

settings.name: H_p
settings.description: 4–8 best measured trade-off; breakdown at H_p=4

data.correctness: Tangram is compared with each compression method's original dynamic implementation while keeping the scorer fixed. Static budgets closely track and sometimes exceed original accuracy across three methods and five models.
data.methodology: All throughput, latency and fragmentation results are actual execution on the stated A100 server, not simulation. Evaluation separates quality, throughput, prefill reclaim cost, decode attention latency, TTFT, and fragmentation/management trade-offs.
data.scope: Strong evidence for vLLM on one A100 server and SCBench multi-turn workloads; no proof that calibration profile or optimal H_p transfers unchanged to other GPU generations, engines, or large workload shifts.
